tasks.title: Accept an import file and add its lines to the library
steps: Add the parsing, refusal and adding behaviours to src/worker/imports/imports.test.ts and confirm they fail

Write parseImportFile in src/worker/imports/parse.ts: refuse a declared type other than text/plain, bytes that are not valid UTF-8 (TextDecoder with fatal), a NUL byte, a first non-blank '<', and a body that parses as a JSON object or array; drop a byte-order mark; split on '\n' and '\r\n'; ignore blank and '#' lines; take each remaining line's first whitespace-separated word with its 1-based line number

Implement POST /api/v1/imports in src/worker/imports/routes.ts for a text/plain body and for multipart/form-data with the part 'file': 400 unsupported_file, 409 import_too_large over 2,097,152 bytes or 5,000 URL lines, 400 no_urls, each with its exact message and nothing stored
Add a migration with the imports table (id, user, created time, counts, invalid and duplicate lines, stopped line) and the import_links table (import, link, line, dispatched time)

Write importLines in src/worker/imports/imports.ts: normalise each line with normalizeUrl; list invalid lines; treat a URL already in the library or seen on an earlier line as a duplicate, without boosting; insert the new links pending, last used from the import time downwards one millisecond per line, in D1 batches, without sending them to the fetch queue; stop at the 20,000-link limit and record the stopping line
Answer 201 with the report {id, created_at, counts, invalid, duplicates, stopped_at_limit}
Document the route in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Dispatch imported links to the fetch worker through the shared throttle
steps: Add the dispatch behaviours to src/worker/imports/imports.test.ts and confirm they fail

Hand each import's links, in line order, to the shared background throttle in src/worker/enrich/throttle.ts, which releases at most 20 links per minute per user across imports and 'enrich all', earlier work first, and sends each released link to the fetch queue
When a waiting link has been deleted or has already been sent to the fetch worker by another action, skip it without using a slot, and record each dispatched link's time in import_links
Keep links added by paste or POST /api/v1/links going straight to the fetch queue, outside the throttle
Describe the import's background processing in docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Report an import's progress and serve its report
steps: Add the progress and report behaviours to src/worker/imports/imports.test.ts and confirm they fail

Implement GET /api/v1/imports/{id}: the stored report plus progress {waiting (not yet dispatched), in_progress (dispatched and still pending), done (left pending), enriched (done and enriched)}, computed from import_links and the links
Implement GET /api/v1/imports/{id}/report as a text/plain attachment named alexandria-import-<YYYY-MM-DD>.txt with the date, the counts, the invalid lines, the duplicates and the stopping line
Answer 404 not_found for an id that is not the user's
Document both routes in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Import from the settings page with a progress view
steps: Add the import behaviours to src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx and confirm they fail
Add an Import section to the Settings page: a file input accepting .txt and text/plain and an 'Import' button that uploads the file to POST /api/v1/imports

Show the progress view from the report: added, duplicates and invalid counts, each invalid line as 'line N: text', the library-limit stop as 'library full (20,000 links): stopped at line N, M lines not imported', the progress counts and a 'Download report' link
Poll GET /api/v1/imports/{id} every 5 seconds while links are waiting or in progress, and stop when both are 0 or the page is left
Show a refusal's message verbatim with no progress view
Describe importing in README.md
